name: com.wultra.pwatest
description: A sample Cordova application that runs PowerAuth tests.

scripts.installPlugin: npm_config_workspaces=false yarn dlx cordova plugin add cordova-powerauth-mobile-sdk --noregistry --searchpath ../packages/cordova-powerauth-mobile-sdk/build/cdv --force
scripts.reinstallPlugin: (npm_config_workspaces=false yarn dlx cordova plugin remove cordova-powerauth-mobile-sdk --no-save --force || true) && yarn rebuildPlugin && yarn installPlugin
scripts.buildAndroid: yarn reinstallPlugin && yarn prepare && yarn dlx cordova build android
scripts.buildIos: yarn reinstallPlugin && yarn prepare && (cd platforms/ios && yarn dlx pod-install --non-interactive && xcodebuild archive -workspace PowerAuthTest.xcworkspace -scheme PowerAuthTest -sdk iphoneos CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO)
scripts.freshAndroid: yarn reinstallPlugin && yarn prepare && yarn android
scripts.freshIos: yarn reinstallPlugin && yarn prepare && yarn pods && yarn ios

author: Apache Cordova Team
